name: segmental_duplication
headline_stat: fraction of reads with high MAPQ placed on wrong copy (confidently_wrong)

construction.description: Build a ~25-50 Mb synthetic genome of N copies of a 1 Mb core block from human chr1, each mutated to a target pairwise identity via SNP/indel injection, separated by unique spacer sequences. Record per-copy identity labels for stratified accuracy scoring.

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 30 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta reads && mv reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz

sweep.notes: Plot accuracy vs. identity to characterize at what identity threshold aligners begin mismapping or reducing MAPQ

truth.eval_notes: Read from copy i must map to copy i. Track: (1) fraction correctly placed, (2) confidently_wrong (MAPQ >= 20, wrong copy), (3) MAPQ calibration at each identity level. confidently_wrong is the headline failure stat.
